assertions.statement: The overview explains ATS, Pyth, HSS, and Mirror roles without claiming Pyth prices the security.
assertions.howToVerify: Open the overview. Confirm four integration cards, the cash-only Pyth boundary, architecture flow, and an explicit reference evidence status.

assertions.statement: The facility exposes reference replay and live wallet modes while keeping writes disabled in reference mode.
assertions.howToVerify: Open the facility with no environment file. Confirm both mode controls and the Pyth update, preview, fund, approve, accept, cancel, repay, settle, and withdraw controls. Confirm writes remain disabled in reference mode.

assertions.statement: Verification distinguishes free ATS balance from held ATS balance and rejects empty Mirror success responses.
assertions.howToVerify: Open verify. Confirm separate free and held fields are part of position evidence and the page warns that HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.

assertions.statement: Contract regression and invariant gates pass with the official HSS helper.
assertions.howToVerify: Run yarn foundry:test, yarn foundry:fuzz, yarn foundry:invariant, and yarn check:ats-abi. Inspect the rail import for @hiero-ledger/hiero-contracts.

assertions.statement: The committed testnet lifecycle can be reconstructed without credentials or simulated entity addresses.
assertions.howToVerify: Open verify with no wallet. Confirm a repaid and defaulted position, distinct hold IDs, terminal path labels, separate Pyth, ATS, liability, reserve, and HSS facts, plus direct HashScan links for every lifecycle receipt.

assertions.statement: The testnet evidence runner keeps signers process-local and publishes only complete, secret-scanned evidence.
assertions.howToVerify: Inspect demo-testnet.mjs and publish-evidence.mjs. Confirm private keys come only from process environment, child processes use secret-free arguments, endpoint origins are allowlisted, temporary accounts are swept, and publication requires full evidence validation plus gitleaks.

assertions.statement: A developer can scaffold, boot, replay, and verify the reference flow in under five minutes without credentials.
assertions.howToVerify: Follow the four-step quick-start path on the overview, boot the app without environment variables, and inspect the facility and verify routes.
